rows.en: Keep Gran Garan armor at 80 percent+
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: The enemy is a mixed force built around the Drake Army, with immense combat strength.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: We cannot let them escape here. You must destroy the enemy fleet completely.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: I am deeply grateful for your cooperation in this battle.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana

rows.en: Drake is no more, and my purpose on the Surface has been fulfilled.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana

rows.en: Even so, until this war is over, I wish to keep aiding all of you on the Surface.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana

rows.en: I pray that true peace will come soon.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana

rows.en: With weak strength, you cannot fight to the end. You must hone yourselves further.
